entries.name: LIGHTSPEED_DOMAIN_PREFIX
entries.description: The store's Lightspeed Retail (X-Series) domain prefix, the part before .retail.lightspeed.app. Not a secret, but it names the client's store.
howToGet: Sign in to the store's Lightspeed Retail and copy the first part of its address: for https://examplestore.retail.lightspeed.app it is examplestore.
This is X-Series (formerly Vend). An R-Series store signs in at a different address and is not supported yet.

entries.name: LIGHTSPEED_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: Client ID of the KaratOS app on Lightspeed's X-Series developer portal, used with the client secret to refresh access tokens.
howToGet: On Lightspeed's X-Series developer portal, open the KaratOS app and copy its client ID straight into the host's secret store.

entries.name: LIGHTSPEED_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: Client secret of the Lightspeed app. It refreshes access tokens and is the key the instance encrypts its stored refresh token with, so rotating it means reconnecting the store.
howToGet: On the app's page on the developer portal, copy the client secret straight into the host's secret store.
After rotating it, reconnect the store and set a new LIGHTSPEED_REFRESH_TOKEN, because the stored token can no longer be decrypted.

entries.name: LIGHTSPEED_REFRESH_TOKEN
entries.description: The refresh token from connecting the store. Lightspeed gives a new one on every refresh, so after the first sync the instance keeps the newest one encrypted in its database and this value only seeds it. Replacing it here (after reconnecting) takes over from the stored one.
howToGet: Have the store's account owner connect the store to the KaratOS app at https://secure.retail.lightspeed.app/connect with exactly these scopes: products:read inventory:read customers:read sales:read.
The connector stops on a connection holding any scope beyond reading, so don't add others.
Copy the refresh token from the token response straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
